test_overview: Regression test verifying Tier 1 Exact Match still works after Tier 3 was added. Executed both steps against the Furniture Delivery Calculator (localhost:8000). Step 1: Created a B2C quote (Warehouse Central, Metroville → Easton/Riverside; 3-Seater Sofa qty 1; all services 0) and clicked Calculate. The result showed an "Exact Match" tier badge (Tier 1, not Tier 3), Total $138.00 — both fatal verifications passed. Non-fatal checks also passed: ratePerM3 $115.00 (lowest of duplicate cards), volume 1.20 m³, base delivery $138.00, no approximate explanation text, and no "View all X approximate matches" link/modal. Step 2: Saved the quote (success confirmation shown), navigated to Quotes list which displayed the "Exact Match" badge and $138.00 total, then opened the detail view where ratePerM3 ($115.00), Volume Charged (1.20 m³), and Base Delivery ($138.00) all matched. All verifications passed — Tier 1 Exact Match takes precedence correctly with no Approximate UI bleeding through. Final score: 15/15.
